subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

Shravan is known for his __compliant__ nature. He is very ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Yielding)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"compliant"** refers to someone or something that is willing to agree with others or obey rules. It describes a behavior that is accommodating, submissive, or conforming. (आज्ञाकारी)

 
 
• **Example:** The new employee was very **compliant**, following all instructions without hesitation.
 
 
 
• **"Yielding"** means being inclined to give way or comply with the wishes or demands of others. It denotes flexibility and an accommodating nature. (झुकनेवाला/समर्पणशील)
 
 
• **Example:** She had a **yielding **nature and was always ready to help her colleagues.
 
 
 
• Since "yielding" is a synonym for "compliant," it is the most appropriate choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Yielding)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Difficult** (कठिन): Something that is hard to deal with or does not yield easily to efforts.

 
 
• **Example:** The task was so **difficult **that it took hours to complete.
 
 
 
• **Complaining** (शिकायत करनेवाला): Frequently expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was always **complaining **about the food in the cafeteria.
 
 
 
• **Adamant** (जिद्दी): Refusing to be persuaded or to change one’s mind; stubborn or inflexible.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the evidence, she remained **adamant **that her decision was correct.
 
 

37:Tb94,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
